supersedes: ranking-20261006-v3.json (left untouched; v3 identity + scores preserved)
livenessRule: alive iff latest line for (source, modelId) across the 8 probe files is PASS
identityRule: v2 EXACT rule plus ONLY format normalization N1-N4. N1: lower-case. N2: treat '.', '_' and '-' as equivalent. N3: strip a leading organisation prefix, only for deepseek-ai/, zai-org/, Qwen/, qwen/, meta-llama/, mistralai/, google/, openai/, MiniMaxAI/, moonshotai/, nvidia/, ibm-granite/, microsoft/. N4: strip a trailing ":free", "-free" or "-instruct" only when the benchmark source lists the model under the base name (benchmarks never carry a :free tier suffix; no probe id ends with -instruct, so that branch is a no-op). A match counts only if the normalized strings are equal. Forbidden and NOT applied: router aliases (kr/*, gh/*, thegrid *-latest/code-*/agent-*/text-*, copilot-*, cl/*, ocz/* non-real ids); mapping a family name to a specific version; stripping version numbers or size tags.

tierRules.livebenchFallback: used only without AA: T1>=79,T2>=73,T3>=66,else T4
